decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the feed for functional backpacks and excluded non-relevant items like towels, chairs, and cookware. My consideration set included a variety of specialized packs: a 70L High Sierra hiking bag, a 35L G4Free tactical bag, a DeMarini baseball bag, a high-end USWE winter pack, and a UDIHEDA hydration pack. I selected the G4Free Tactical Shoulder Backpack (prod_backpacks_050) as the final choice because it offers the best combination of versatility, capacity (35L), and strong user ratings (4.6) at a very affordable price point compared to the specialized technical packs.
